name: util-linux

commands.command:
touch /etc/fstab
chown -R tester .
su tester -c "make -k check"

description: The Util-linux package contains miscellaneous utility programs. Among them are utilities for handling file systems, consoles, partitions, and messages.

installed_descriptions.name: addpart
installed_descriptions.description: Informs the Linux kernel of new partitions

installed_descriptions.name: agetty
installed_descriptions.description: Opens a tty port, prompts for a login name, and then invokes the login program

installed_descriptions.name: blkdiscard
installed_descriptions.description: Discards sectors on a device

installed_descriptions.name: blkid
installed_descriptions.description: A command line utility to locate and print block device attributes

installed_descriptions.name: blkzone
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to manage zoned storage block devices

installed_descriptions.name: blockdev
installed_descriptions.description: Allows users to call block device ioctls from the command line

installed_descriptions.name: cal
installed_descriptions.description: Displays a simple calendar

installed_descriptions.name: cfdisk
installed_descriptions.description: Manipulates the partition table of the given device

installed_descriptions.name: chcpu
installed_descriptions.description: Modifies the state of CPUs

installed_descriptions.name: chmem
installed_descriptions.description: Configures memory

installed_descriptions.name: choom
installed_descriptions.description: Displays and adjusts OOM-killer scores, used to determine which process to kill first when Linux is Out Of Memory

installed_descriptions.name: chrt
installed_descriptions.description: Manipulates real-time attributes of a process

installed_descriptions.name: col
installed_descriptions.description: Filters out reverse line feeds

installed_descriptions.name: colcrt
installed_descriptions.description: Filters nroff output for terminals that lack some capabilities, such as overstriking and half-lines

installed_descriptions.name: colrm
installed_descriptions.description: Filters out the given columns

installed_descriptions.name: column
installed_descriptions.description: Formats a given file into multiple columns

installed_descriptions.name: ctrlaltdel
installed_descriptions.description: Sets the function of the Ctrl+Alt+Del key combination to a hard or a soft reset

installed_descriptions.name: delpart
installed_descriptions.description: Asks the Linux kernel to remove a partition

installed_descriptions.name: dmesg
installed_descriptions.description: Dumps the kernel boot messages

installed_descriptions.name: eject
installed_descriptions.description: Ejects removable media

installed_descriptions.name: fallocate
installed_descriptions.description: Preallocates space to a file

installed_descriptions.name: fdisk
installed_descriptions.description: Manipulates the partition table of the given device

installed_descriptions.name: fincore
installed_descriptions.description: Counts pages of file contents in core

installed_descriptions.name: findfs
installed_descriptions.description: Finds a file system, either by label or Universally Unique Identifier (UUID)

installed_descriptions.name: findmnt
installed_descriptions.description: Is a command line interface to the libmount library for working with mountinfo, fstab and mtab files

installed_descriptions.name: flock
installed_descriptions.description: Acquires a file lock and then executes a command with the lock held

installed_descriptions.name: fsck
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to check, and optionally repair, file systems

installed_descriptions.name: fsck.cramfs
installed_descriptions.description: Performs a consistency check on the Cramfs file system on the given device

installed_descriptions.name: fsck.minix
installed_descriptions.description: Performs a consistency check on the Minix file system on the given device

installed_descriptions.name: fsfreeze
installed_descriptions.description: Is a very simple wrapper around FIFREEZE/FITHAW ioctl kernel driver operations

installed_descriptions.name: fstrim
installed_descriptions.description: Discards unused blocks on a mounted filesystem

installed_descriptions.name: getopt
installed_descriptions.description: Parses options in the given command line

installed_descriptions.name: hardlink
installed_descriptions.description: Consolidates duplicate files by creating hard links

installed_descriptions.name: hexdump
installed_descriptions.description: Dumps the given file in hexadecimal, decimal, octal, or ascii

installed_descriptions.name: hwclock
installed_descriptions.description: Reads or sets the system's hardware clock, also called the Real-Time Clock (RTC) or Basic Input-Output System (BIOS) clock

installed_descriptions.name: i386
installed_descriptions.description: A symbolic link to setarch

installed_descriptions.name: ionice
installed_descriptions.description: Gets or sets the io scheduling class and priority for a program

installed_descriptions.name: ipcmk
installed_descriptions.description: Creates various IPC resources

installed_descriptions.name: ipcrm
installed_descriptions.description: Removes the given Inter-Process Communication (IPC) resource

installed_descriptions.name: ipcs
installed_descriptions.description: Provides IPC status information

installed_descriptions.name: irqtop
installed_descriptions.description: Displays kernel interrupt counter information in top(1) style view

installed_descriptions.name: isosize
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the size of an iso9660 file system

installed_descriptions.name: kill
installed_descriptions.description: Sends signals to processes

installed_descriptions.name: last
installed_descriptions.description: Shows which users last logged in (and out), searching back through the /var/log/wtmp file; it also shows system boots, shutdowns, and run-level changes

installed_descriptions.name: lastb
installed_descriptions.description: Shows the failed login attempts, as logged in /var/log/btmp

installed_descriptions.name: ldattach
installed_descriptions.description: Attaches a line discipline to a serial line

installed_descriptions.name: linux32
installed_descriptions.description: A symbolic link to setarch

installed_descriptions.name: linux64
installed_descriptions.description: A symbolic link to setarch

installed_descriptions.name: logger
installed_descriptions.description: Enters the given message into the system log

installed_descriptions.name: look
installed_descriptions.description: Displays lines that begin with the given string

installed_descriptions.name: losetup
installed_descriptions.description: Sets up and controls loop devices

installed_descriptions.name: lsblk
installed_descriptions.description: Lists information about all or selected block devices in a tree-like format

installed_descriptions.name: lscpu
installed_descriptions.description: Prints CPU architecture information

installed_descriptions.name: lsfd
installed_descriptions.description: Displays information about open files; replaces lsof

installed_descriptions.name: lsipc
installed_descriptions.description: Prints information on IPC facilities currently employed in the system

installed_descriptions.name: lsirq
installed_descriptions.description: Displays kernel interrupt counter information

installed_descriptions.name: lslocks
installed_descriptions.description: Lists local system locks

installed_descriptions.name: lslogins
installed_descriptions.description: Lists information about users, groups and system accounts

installed_descriptions.name: lsmem
installed_descriptions.description: Lists the ranges of available memory with their online status

installed_descriptions.name: lsns
installed_descriptions.description: Lists namespaces

installed_descriptions.name: mcookie
installed_descriptions.description: Generates magic cookies (128-bit random hexadecimal numbers) for xauth

installed_descriptions.name: mesg
installed_descriptions.description: Controls whether other users can send messages to the current user's terminal

installed_descriptions.name: mkfs
installed_descriptions.description: Builds a file system on a device (usually a hard disk partition)

installed_descriptions.name: mkfs.bfs
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a Santa Cruz Operations (SCO) bfs file system

installed_descriptions.name: mkfs.cramfs
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a cramfs file system

installed_descriptions.name: mkfs.minix
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a Minix file system

installed_descriptions.name: mkswap
installed_descriptions.description: Initializes the given device or file to be used as a swap area

installed_descriptions.name: more
installed_descriptions.description: A filter for paging through text one screen at a time

installed_descriptions.name: mount
installed_descriptions.description: Attaches the file system on the given device to a specified directory in the file-system tree

installed_descriptions.name: mountpoint
installed_descriptions.description: Checks if the directory is a mountpoint

installed_descriptions.name: namei
installed_descriptions.description: Shows the symbolic links in the given paths

installed_descriptions.name: nsenter
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a program with namespaces of other processes

installed_descriptions.name: partx
installed_descriptions.description: Tells the kernel about the presence and numbering of on-disk partitions

installed_descriptions.name: pivot_root
installed_descriptions.description: Makes the given file system the new root file system of the current process

installed_descriptions.name: prlimit
installed_descriptions.description: Gets and sets a process's resource limits

installed_descriptions.name: readprofile
installed_descriptions.description: Reads kernel profiling information

installed_descriptions.name: rename
installed_descriptions.description: Renames the given files, replacing a given string with another

installed_descriptions.name: renice
installed_descriptions.description: Alters the priority of running processes

installed_descriptions.name: resizepart
installed_descriptions.description: Asks the Linux kernel to resize a partition

installed_descriptions.name: rev
installed_descriptions.description: Reverses the lines of a given file

installed_descriptions.name: rfkill
installed_descriptions.description: Tool for enabling and disabling wireless devices

installed_descriptions.name: rtcwake
installed_descriptions.description: Used to enter a system sleep state until the specified wakeup time

installed_descriptions.name: script
installed_descriptions.description: Makes a typescript of a terminal session

installed_descriptions.name: scriptlive
installed_descriptions.description: Re-runs session typescripts using timing information

installed_descriptions.name: scriptreplay
installed_descriptions.description: Plays back typescripts using timing information

installed_descriptions.name: setarch
installed_descriptions.description: Changes reported architecture in a new program environment, and sets personality flags

installed_descriptions.name: setsid
installed_descriptions.description: Runs the given program in a new session

installed_descriptions.name: setterm
installed_descriptions.description: Sets terminal attributes

installed_descriptions.name: sfdisk
installed_descriptions.description: A disk partition table manipulator

installed_descriptions.name: sulogin
installed_descriptions.description: Allows root to log in; it is normally invoked by init when the system goes into single user mode

installed_descriptions.name: swaplabel
installed_descriptions.description: Makes changes to the swap area's UUID and label

installed_descriptions.name: swapoff
installed_descriptions.description: Disables devices and files for paging and swapping

installed_descriptions.name: swapon
installed_descriptions.description: Enables devices and files for paging and swapping, and lists the devices and files currently in use

installed_descriptions.name: switch_root
installed_descriptions.description: Switches to another filesystem as the root of the mount tree

installed_descriptions.name: taskset
installed_descriptions.description: Retrieves or sets a process's CPU affinity

installed_descriptions.name: uclampset
installed_descriptions.description: Manipulates the utilization clamping attributes of the system or a process

installed_descriptions.name: ul
installed_descriptions.description: A filter for translating underscores into escape sequences indicating underlining for the terminal in use

installed_descriptions.name: umount
installed_descriptions.description: Disconnects a file system from the system's file tree

installed_descriptions.name: uname26
installed_descriptions.description: A symbolic link to setarch

installed_descriptions.name: unshare
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a program with some namespaces unshared from parent

installed_descriptions.name: utmpdump
installed_descriptions.description: Displays the content of the given login file in a user-friendly format

installed_descriptions.name: uuidd
installed_descriptions.description: A daemon used by the UUID library to generate time-based UUIDs in a secure and guaranteed-unique fashion

installed_descriptions.name: uuidgen
installed_descriptions.description: Creates new UUIDs. Each new UUID is a random number likely to be unique among all UUIDs created, on the local system and on other systems, in the past and in the future, with extremely high probability (2128 UUIDs are possible)

installed_descriptions.name: uuidparse
installed_descriptions.description: A utility to parse unique identifiers

installed_descriptions.name: wall
installed_descriptions.description: Displays the contents of a file or, by default, its standard input, on the terminals of all currently logged in users

installed_descriptions.name: wdctl
installed_descriptions.description: Shows hardware watchdog status

installed_descriptions.name: whereis
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the location of the binary, source, and man page files for the given command

installed_descriptions.name: wipefs
installed_descriptions.description: Wipes a filesystem signature from a device

installed_descriptions.name: x86_64
installed_descriptions.description: A symbolic link to setarch

installed_descriptions.name: zramctl
installed_descriptions.description: A program to set up and control zram (compressed ram disk) devices

installed_descriptions.name: libblkid
installed_descriptions.description: Contains routines for device identification and token extraction

installed_descriptions.name: libfdisk
installed_descriptions.description: Contains routines for manipulating partition tables

installed_descriptions.name: libmount
installed_descriptions.description: Contains routines for block device mounting and unmounting

installed_descriptions.name: libsmartcols
installed_descriptions.description: Contains routines for aiding screen output in tabular form

installed_descriptions.name: libuuid
installed_descriptions.description: Contains routines for generating unique identifiers for objects that may be accessible beyond the local system
